evaluation_scope: Amended independent round-1 review after actual installed Claude CLI 2.1.295 failed fake-only protocol smoke. Credit authority and admitted-request guard checks pass; usable cloud Claude executor integration has not passed.
scoring_notes: 27/33 acceptance criteria verified (floor 24/30). Default Go suite remains green, but required real executor protocol smoke fails, so Tests Pass receives zero and functional local readiness PASS is withdrawn. Milestone M4 and integrated M5 next-request observation remain blocked, as does live M6.

hard_fails.details: Installed Claude CLI 2.1.295 sends mandatory interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14, mid-conversation-system-2026-04-07, claude-code-20250219 and effort-2025-11-24 beta headers. Gateway rejects HTTP 400 unsupported beta feature before reservation/upstream forwarding. Experimental-beta disable and custom-header beta pin did not provide a compatible supported protocol.
hard_fails.output_snippet: TestClaudeCLIProtocolSmoke: exit status 1; API Error: 400 unsupported beta feature

hard_fails.details: M6 live shared-authority rollout, authentication/protocol check, provider billing reconciliation and required CI are incomplete. Lane remains disabled; no spending guarantee against the actual key/account is asserted yet.

automated_checks.note: Independent evaluator inspected final unrestricted checkpoint, complete isolated proctree regression and limited-concurrency whole-suite logs once, without rerunning tests. Default gates pass after resource-pressure recheck; incompatible actual CLI mandatory betas remain a distinct failing feature gate. No test-source or beta allowlist changes occurred.
automated_checks.tests_note: All default tests pass with Go package concurrency limited to four; all original test cases remain. Required opt-in installed Claude protocol smoke still fails, so overall functional test readiness fails.
automated_checks.final_default_checkpoint_status: initial unrestricted checkpoint failed two process-start fixture deadlines; isolated adapter recheck and full limited-concurrency suite subsequently passed

checkpoint_failure_details.subsequent_evidence: All adapter variants pass isolated; full make test with go test -p 4 passes, no test-source changes. Process-start pressure is an inference from rechecks, not a proved root-cause diagnosis.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Same-cycle reconfirmation adds zero allowance; key rotation/restarts/date changes do not replenish it.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Historical replay, same-cycle confirmation, restart policy and renewal tests preserve spend; Configure cannot overwrite policy or enable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Duplicate settlement is harmless; lease expiry never refunds forwarded or unknown exposure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: TestForwardingCannotRefundAndDuplicateSettlementIsHarmless, TestDailyCeilingAndLeaseExpiryNeverRefund and crash-intent tests preserve money through lease release, expiry and repeated settlement.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Expiry, kill switch, storage failure, and unresolved grant transitions prevent new admission.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Expiry/kill-switch/storage-failure/reconciliation predicates are checked before Reserve and before durable send intent; unknown exposure survives renewal.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Relevant tests and formatting/lint pass.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Final full default suite passes via make test GOTEST=go test -p 4; lint passes. Emulator/race/vet evidence remains /private/tmp/ailang-credit-m1-validation.log. Initial process-start fixtures passed isolated and in the complete limited-concurrency suite.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Tests cover exactly 100K and above, cache reads, five-minute/one-hour writes, thinking/output limits, and upward rounding.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: credit_pricing_test.go covers 100000/100001 boundary, all disjoint cache categories and TTLs, hidden thinking/output cap and upward micro-dollar rounding.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unknown model/feature/rate or unproved token bound cannot authorize a request.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Canonical card requires loaded verified exact model, positive bounded rates and explicit 1M/128K contract; unknown features rejected before Reserve by nested gateway tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing pricing tests pass without changing unrelated model rates or ordering.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing scalar model rates/order remain unchanged; registry checks and final complete default suite with Go package concurrency four pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Request and settlement record the pricing revision used.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Reservation.PricingRevision stores immutable rate-card digest; ClaudeUsageCostAtRevision refuses changed card and leaves reservation held.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every upstream send has its own durable sufficient reservation, including retry/helper/subagent paths admitted by the contract.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Gateway generates a new request UUID for every actual send, atomically reserves worst case, then durably MarkForwarded before http.Client.Do. TestEverySendHasReservationAndOnlyGatewayKey observes held exposure at transport entry.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Crash around sending, truncated SSE, client cancellation, duplicate events, and gateway restart preserve conservative exposure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: fault_test.go tests detached client cancellation, reserve/forward/settle/unknown-marker storage faults; lifecycle tests test truncated SSE and event inconsistencies; ledger crash/restart tests retain forwarding exposure.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unsupported billable routes/features/models and invalid credentials produce zero upstream inference calls.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Strict nested allowlists, duplicate JSON rejection, model/beta/route validation and job identity/capability checks precede reservation/send; zero-upstream tests cover unsupported paths/features.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Provider key remains gateway-only; capabilities cannot choose another account or enlarge limits.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Only gateway runtime loads provider key. Capability binds account/task/attempt/job identity/expiry. Isolated authority project and key-only gateway IAM are explicit unfulfilled activation gates, not claimed deployed guarantees.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Fixed-origin and streaming contract tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invalid/missing budgets fail closed rather than become zero/unlimited.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Dispatch and child reject missing/malformed/nonfinite/nonpositive/over-$2 budgets; admission floors micro-dollar ceilings and rejects sub-micro requests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Budget-blocked work does not spin on retries or silently switch credentials/models.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: API auth remains apikey/metered; subscription accounting is unchanged. Executor environment strips alternative credentials/routes and pins all helper models.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Operator-only gateway admin routes authenticate Google identity; server supplies audit actor. CLI accepts grant evidence, never API-key input. Firestore Confirm atomically commits grant/account.

design_fidelity.notes: Approved shared-request authority, integer ceilings, audited immutable grants, credential isolation proposal and conservative admitted-request pricing are implemented. The frozen goal of usable Claude cloud executors is currently blocked by mandatory CLI betas outside that contract. Rejecting them protects credits; it does not establish executor readiness. No broadened or unverified pricing contract is approved.

resolved_findings.issue: Nested feature contracts and tool cache TTLs were forwarded without exhaustive supported-field/value validation. Unknown message/content fields also passed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Strict nested/content/message and cache TTL allowlists added; TestUnknownNestedFeaturesNeverReserveOrForward passes with zero exposure/sends.

resolved_findings.issue: Private Cloud Run transport relied on a single authenticating Authorization header while application performs independent JWT validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Paired X-Serverless-Authorization and Authorization headers preserve application-verifiable token; all CLI, admission, release and Claude child paths assert the contract. Live token behavior still requires nonbillable canary preflight.

resolved_findings.issue: Admitted concurrency slots were never released on completed jobs or known failures before launch.
resolved_findings.resolution: Attempt-scoped release route/authority, known rejected-launch cleanup and outer execute-job defer implemented; stale attempt cannot release newer lease; money remains reserved.

resolved_findings.issue: Successful gateway release HTTP 204 was initially treated as failure by client expecting 200.
resolved_findings.resolution: Client accepts 204/200; authenticated scoped release regression passes.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial Cloud Run service timeout was shorter than supported upstream request deadline.
resolved_findings.resolution: Service timeout now 660s, matching ten-minute request plus settlement/cleanup headroom.

implementation_issues.issue: Installed Claude 2.1.295 emits mandatory beta headers that the gateway must currently refuse; the executor lane cannot complete even a one-turn fake-only request.
implementation_issues.suggestion: Keep existing allowlist and activation disabled. Establish an approved, bounded and compatible executor protocol or verified compatible pinned CLI/image before claiming readiness; rerun fake-only protocol smoke before any provider-backed canary. This review does not authorize broadening the allowlist or bypassing automatic approval review.
